subject: Upcoming Company Retreat - RSVP Required
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming company retreat scheduled for the first weekend of November. This year, we will be heading to a beautiful resort in the mountains for team building activities and strategy sessions. As space is limited, we kindly request that you RSVP by the end of this week to secure your spot. Please let us know of any dietary restrictions or accommodations needed. We look forward to a productive and fun retreat! Best regards, [Company Name]
